```yaml
  Test predicate evaluation challenged on the (iv) algebraic envelope

  signature. Solution-space update: §W6-2 K-counter advancement
  blocked; corpus rows NOT appended; downstream §W6-5 FWD-C5 K-counter
  advancement (which depends on the cross-pillar-bridge-corpus K-
  counter infrastructure being clean at landing time) routes per

  The K-counter advancements are NOT empirical statements about the
  substrate; they are accumulations of substrate-IS structural
  conclusions at the methodology-rule layer. Each K-counter increment
  records that a STRUCTURALLY INDEPENDENT calibration instance has been
  added to the corresponding corpus; promotion to MANDATORY at K=3
  records that the rule is calibrated by enough structurally
  independent substrate-IS instances to be enforced at plan-freeze.

  Container-thinking violation FORBIDDEN: "K=1 → K=2 means the rule is
  becoming more confident in its prediction" → INVERT: "K=1 → K=2 means
  one additional STRUCTURALLY INDEPENDENT calibration instance has
  landed; the rule's status remains SUGGESTION at K=2; promotion to
  MANDATORY is contingent on K=3 calibration corpus saturation across
  structurally INDEPENDENT loci per the Hybrid Independence Test
  predicate". K-counter advancement is corpus accumulation, NOT
  confidence accumulation.

  Classification: NON-PHONONIC — METHODOLOGY-class corpus-row landing;
  the substrate-physics content (S91 §W2-1 PASS-V FULL CM-1995 §III.4
  multi-regulator evaluation; §W6-1 §VII.AX.MULTI-PIN-ATLAS landing)
  was already discharged; this gate is the methodology-rule
  reification of the structural PASS-V conclusion at the corpus level.
```

```yaml
# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: |
  K=2 in-session advancement landed at `cross-pillar-bridge-corpus.md
  §4` FWD-C5 corpus: cardinality-cascade-shoulder observable
  n_PBH_shoulder(g) at substrate-distance-3 pole `s=5` IS the K=2
  calibration corpus instance; Hybrid Independence Test predicate
  `(YES ∨ NO ∨ NO) ∧ YES = TRUE` (distinct substrate-IS pillar at
  shoulder regime + structurally independent shoulder-regime envelope);
  volovik CO-AUTHOR substrate-physics independence audit PASS on (iv)
  algebraic envelope axis. K=3 forward target pre-registered: PBH
  MASS SPECTRAL DENSITY `dM_PBH/dV` at Pillar IX mass-bin-resolved
  sub-pillar; forward-promoting gate `S93-OR-LATER-FWD-C5-K3-
  MANDATORY-PROMOTION-DISTINCT-PILLAR-IX-LAB-OBSERVABLE-LANDING`;
  substrate-IS derivation outline + effort estimate ~1.5 wave-
  equivalents documented. Solution-space update: FWD-C5 bridge family
  K-counter advances SUGGESTION K=1 → SUGGESTION K=2 (does NOT reach
  MANDATORY at K=3; K=3 target deferred to S93+); the K=3 landing
  at S93+ would complete SUGGESTION → MANDATORY promotion per
  `feedback_rules-compensate-missing-structure.md` K-counter
  promotion threshold.

FAIL_meaning: |
  At least one of: (a) K=2 substrate-physics derivation of
  n_PBH_shoulder(g) closed form FAIL (e.g., shoulder regime extraction
  from S88 W1a-59 canonical form produces inconsistent g-dependence
  with the saturated regime g-independence theorem); (b) Hybrid
  Independence Test predicate at K=2 returns FALSE structurally (e.g.,
  shoulder regime envelope IS a numerical refinement of saturated
  regime envelope rather than structurally independent — fails (iv));
  (c) volovik CO-AUTHOR substrate-physics independence audit FAIL on
  (iv) algebraic envelope axis; (d) K=2 corpus-row append FAIL OR
  content_sha256 mismatch; (e) K=3 target identification ambiguous
  (multiple candidate Pillar IX laboratory observables; no unique
  structural choice); (f) K=3 forward-promoting gate identifier NOT
  pre-registered. Solution-space update: FWD-C5 K-counter PRESERVED at
  K=1 SUGGESTION; SUGGESTION → MANDATORY promotion further deferred;
  recovery pathway depends on FAIL mode (substrate-physics derivation
  retry, alternative K=2 candidate identification, or K=3 target
  disambiguation workshop).

INFO_meaning: |
  K=2 in-session landing complete (PASS sub-conditions (a)-(d)); K=3
  target identification incomplete (e.g., ambiguity between PBH mass
  spectral density `dM_PBH/dV` AND alternative candidates such as PBH
  binary merger rate channel at LISA-decisive band). Solution-space
  update: FWD-C5 advances to K=2 SUGGESTION at S92; K=3 target
  identification deferred to follow-up workshop at S93+; SUGGESTION →
  MANDATORY promotion timeline extended.
```
